title: A kind-agnostic review surface
summary: Provide a persistent generic review queue for conflicts that cannot be resolved silently.
produces: Keep-both and merge decisions for baseline-absence tombstone conflicts
Rename prompt for natural-key keep-both collisions

conditions: Keep both leaves both records present.
Natural-key keep-both resolution cannot complete without a distinct name.
completion.summary: PR #1279 is merged and delivers the persisted, kind-agnostic review surface with transactional resolution, restart durability, Keep-both handling, and distinct-name validation.
evidence: PR #1279 (merge commit c29ef6cf4eda6cce423f7e80f276507c8eb70403) adds the persisted review queue surface, transactional Merge and Keep-both decisions, strict candidate validation, natural-key rename handling, and the localized review UI.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/sync_storage_test.dart covers Keep-both resolution for every supported natural-key kind, consumes resolved queue rows, survives a file-backed close and reopen before resolution, and verifies rollback when the production write seam fails.

app/test/sync_review_screen_test.dart covers Keep-both validation requiring a name and rejecting an occupied natural key, actionable live-dance ambiguity actions, and retained unsupported rows without unsafe actions.
The W14 rollback guard was mutation-proven: removing the outer resolution transaction made the renamed local key persist after an injected write failure; restoring the transaction made the test pass.
PR #1279 reports fvm dart/flutter focused suites passing and python3 tools/preflight.py passing all 30 available gates with zero skips.
No schema migration or new persisted field was introduced; W14 reuses W4's persisted review_queue and W7's production reconciliation machinery.
